layers.authority: Phong Nha - Ke Bang National Park Management Board (Ban quan ly Vuon quoc gia Phong Nha - Ke Bang)
layers.process: The park board lists its adventure caves as products run by named companies under contracts with the board. Oxalis runs the Son Doong tour, Hang Va and Hang Nuoc Nut, the Rao Thuong - Hang En trek and the Hang Ba - Dai Cao tour. Jungle Boss runs Ha Ma Da - Hang Tra Ang, Dai A / Over / Pygmy and Hang Hung Thoong. Phong Nha Heritage runs the Hang O Ro and Hang Hoan My adventure tours. AREM runs Bach Xanh - Hang Kling. The board's page describes no way to enter these caves independently, so the route it publishes is to book with the company named for that cave. The board also says visitors' health is checked before some of the discovery and adventure programs.

layers.authority: Phong Nha - Ke Bang National Park Management Board
layers.process: The mass-visit caves (Phong Nha, Tien Son and the Thien Duong cave eco-tourism area, which a company runs under a forest lease) are separate paid products. The board's tourism page does not list ticket prices, so the amount for each cave was not confirmed from an official page; ask the board (tourism line 094 834 6555, as printed on its site).

sources.title: Du lich Phong Nha - Ke Bang (tourism page)
sources.authority: Phong Nha - Ke Bang National Park Management Board
sources.supports: which companies operate Son Doong and the other adventure caves; health checks before some programs; park address in Quang Tri province

zone-requirements.note: Quang Binh province joined Quang Tri on 1 July 2025; the park board's own address is now Phong Nha commune, Quang Tri province. The page is in Vietnamese and was read directly on 2026-11-07. Prices and the number of Son Doong places were not on the board's page.
